name: Category Quick Links
description: Context-aware horizontal navigation for the current category children, with an optional alternate source category and storefront-only sticky behavior.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Category Quick Links
attribute_definition_groups.description: Context-aware horizontal navigation for the current category children, with an optional alternate source category and storefront-only sticky behavior.

attribute_definitions.name: Source category override
attribute_definitions.description: Optional category whose immediate children become links. Leave empty to use the current category.

attribute_definitions.name: Visible title
attribute_definitions.description: Optional heading displayed before the links.

attribute_definitions.name: Accessible navigation label
attribute_definitions.description: Concise label announced for this navigation when no visible title is provided.

attribute_definitions.name: Sticky below header
attribute_definitions.description: Keeps the links below the storefront header while scrolling. Disabled in Page Designer edit mode.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop alignment
attribute_definitions.description: Links remain horizontally scrollable on small screens.

attribute_definitions.name: Maximum links
attribute_definitions.description: Limits the current category children displayed, from one to twenty.
